title: Praying Mantises Catch and Eat Birds Alive: 147 Cases Found

scenes.text: Praying mantises catch and eat live birds.
A 2017 study found 147 cases, on every continent except Antarctica.
About 70 percent of the victims were hummingbirds.
The mantis waits, strikes with its front legs, and bites the head or neck.
It has no venom. It just eats them alive.
Only about 2 percent of the captured birds escaped without help.

description:
A 2017 review found 147 cases of praying mantises catching and eating birds, on every continent except Antarctica.
About 70 percent were hummingbirds, and only about 2 percent escaped without human help.
Would you have guessed a bug could do this?
first_comment: What is the strangest predator you have ever seen?
